summary: Iter 12 backend-only security follow-up passed. Provider-off OTP now fails closed on verify/request endpoints with preserved throttling, and no outbound MSG91/Traccar call evidence during verify test execution.
action_items: Optional hygiene: standardize frontend backend URL key to EXPO_BACKEND_URL in addition to EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL if platform policy requires a single naming convention.
Keep monitoring backend logs for any reappearance of outbound MSG91 verify calls in provider-off mode.
critical_code_review_comments: verify_otp now enforces rate limit first and returns 503 when SMS provider is unavailable before provider-specific verification calls.
server.py is very large (>700 lines); split auth/payments/complaints/admin into focused modules for maintainability and safer security reviews.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use test_iter12_provider_off_security.py for provider-off OTP regression baseline. It includes verify/request throttling checks and log-based guard against MSG91 verify call traces during fail-closed verify flow.
rca_of_issue: Prior behavior allowed /auth/verify-otp to fall through to MSG91 verify path when provider config was absent. Current patch places provider-off 503 guard immediately after throttle enforcement and before provider call branches; verified by endpoint behavior (503/429) and absence of new outbound provider request traces in backend logs during test run.
